g.title: ocr
g.text: OCR recovery and safe rejection paths

g.title: NO_STOCK_WRITTEN
g.text: Stopped safely: no invoice or stock from this attempt

g.title: RETRY_REJECTED
g.text: Retry rejected: historical stock remains unverified

g.title: MISSING_DIRECT_URL->MISSING_RETAINED
g.text: Initial read failure retains exact invoice

g.title: CANCELLED
g.text: Unposted intake rejected: retain originals and history

g.title: WRONG_DOCUMENT->DRAFT_REVIEW
g.text: Upload correct invoice or verified manual entry

g.title: FIELD_BLOCKED->DRAFT_REVIEW
g.text: Correct the named field against the original

g.title: HISTORICAL_STOCK_HOLD->CANCELLED
g.text: Reject unposted invoice; reconcile physical stock separately in Counts & audit

g.title: REVIEWED_LINKED_RECEIPT
g.text: Ready to Post bill: stock received earlier

g.title: DUPLICATE_DRAFT->DRAFT_REVIEW
g.text: Open exact existing unposted invoice and compare retained entry

g.title: DUPLICATE_COMMITTED->COMMITTED
g.text: Open exact existing committed invoice; do not add stock again

g.title: STALE_DRAFT->DRAFT_REVIEW
g.text: Compare with authoritative unposted saved version
